scope_notes: Marginal intervals quantify synchronized task-bootstrap uncertainty only.
Primary estimates use five runs for original methods and three runs for rebuttal-added methods.
Matched-three-run sensitivity covers ID-Q, OOD-G, SYM-F, EFF, and ROBU.
Matched-three-run ROBU uses the two common noise levels; STAB is excluded.
EFF retains the archived proxy-component definition in the primary analysis.

STAB uses the formal SYM-F in its performance correction (paper F.5) for the 12 original methods. The 3 rebuttal-added methods keep their archived STAB because their per-seed structural inputs were not preserved, so STAB is mixed-provenance across cohorts and cross-cohort STAB gaps should not be over-interpreted.
